notes: ACQUISITION: A10 Networks acquired TrojAI Inc. on 2026-06-15 (press release). The AI security product is now branded TrojAI by A10 Networks, with TrojAI Detect, Defend, Defend for MCP and Defend for Employee Usage. A10 also sells two separate products. The A10 AI Firewall is a hardware, GPU-enabled inline firewall in front of LLM APIs, shown at Interop Tokyo in June 2025. The A10 AI Gateway went GA on 2026-08-13 and does LLM routing, budgets and virtual keys, with only regex guardrails built in. A10 says it plans to fold TrojAI into its portfolio. TrojAI's own April 2025 blog explains model scanning, and a JFrog partner post says JFrog Xray does the model scanning, so no TrojAI scanner is listed on the current product page. TrojAI integrates with JFrog Artifactory and TrueFoundry AI Gateway. Defend is self-hosted or cloud, with AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and OpenShift listed. Less sure: 4.1 (reverse proxy plus TrueFoundry plus employee browser monitoring counted as three modes), 5.3 (reports exist, export not documented), 3.2 (SIEM, SOAR and ticketing named only as categories).
